primaryChecks.text: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of those who worked fine linen, of the house of Ashbea;
primaryChecks.previousContext: The sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben Hanan, and Tilon. The sons of Ishi: Zoheth, and Ben Zoheth.
primaryChecks.nextContext: and Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. These records are ancient.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 文脈上の地理句との関係はあり得るが固有名の明記がなく、無理に同定しない。

wikipediaRead.supportParaphraseJa: Wikipedia内で “Beth-ashbea”, “Beth Ashbea”, “Ashbea” を検索。適切な地名記事は確認できず。記事候補として見つかった外部辞典は、本箇所を「家／居住地」とも読み、場所は不明とするため確定的な地名記事の根拠には採らない。
